question: When and where is the conference?
answer: The 10th APRU Sustainable Cities and Landscapes Conference takes place 21—23 May 2027 in Singapore, hosted by the Department of Architecture at the National University of Singapore. The exact venue within NUS will be announced closer to the event.

question: Who is the conference for?
answer: Scholars, educators, practitioners, students, and community partners working on sustainable cities and landscapes across the Pacific Rim. The conference is open beyond APRU member universities — the working group framework is built around cross-institutional and cross-disciplinary collaboration.

question: What is APRU-SCL?
answer: The Sustainable Cities and Landscapes (SCL) program of the Association of Pacific Rim Universities convenes an annual conference and a set of ongoing thematic working groups. The 2027 edition in Singapore marks the network's 10th anniversary.

question: How do I submit an abstract?
answer: The call for abstracts has not opened yet. When it does, submissions of papers, posters, and panels will be handled through the conference submission platform, with a 200-word abstract. Register your interest to be notified the day the call opens.

question: Is there anything for students?
answer: Yes. A pre-conference student symposium is planned for graduate and doctoral students, and student registration rates will be published alongside general rates when registration opens.

question: How do the working groups work?
answer: Working groups are ongoing thematic groups that meet at each annual conference to build joint agendas and shared outputs — publications, case studies, white papers, and webinars — rather than deliver static paper presentations. Twelve groups are confirmed for 2027; details on joining will follow with the programme.

question: When does registration open, and what will it cost?
answer: Registration is not yet open and fees have not been set. General and student rates will both be published here when they are confirmed.

question: How do I stay informed?
answer: Register your interest using the link on any page of this site. It is a single form, and it is the channel we will use to announce the call for abstracts, the program, speakers, and registration.
